item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We refuse to trade our collective agency for a technology we cannot govern.

2. We will not call it progress when humanity loses the power to shape its own future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that loss of control will be permanent. We must stop this race.

3. We want a future shaped by people, not dictated by superintelligent machines. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We are organising to prevent that outcome.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We reject the idea that this is a price worth paying for faster innovation, greater profits, or technological prestige. Our collective future is not an experiment, and we will not surrender the power to decide what happens to our communities, our children, and generations still to come. We are organising to stop the race toward superintelligence and demand limits that protect human agency. We have a responsibility to act before that power is lost, because permanent loss of control leaves no second chance.
